title: Agent Frontmatter mcpServers Field for --agent Sessions (v2.1.117)
description: In v2.1.117, `mcpServers` declared in agent frontmatter are now loaded when the agent runs as a main-thread agent via `claude --agent agent-name`. Previously, agent-level MCP server declarations only worked in subagent (Task tool) mode. This enables self-contained agents that bundle their own MCP server dependencies — an agent can declare a specific MCP server in its frontmatter and it will be available whether invoked via Task tool or `--agent` flag. Distinct from existing global `~/.claude.json` mcpServers and from the Plugin bin/ executables pattern (v2.1.91). Companion to the v2.1.116 improvement that made frontmatter hooks: fire in --agent mode.
redundancy_check: NOVEL — registry documents agent frontmatter fields (effort, maxTurns, disallowedTools, hooks) but NOT mcpServers. This is a new frontmatter key with meaningfully different capability: agents can now carry their own MCP server configurations.
preliminary_notes: Score likely 75-85. Enables self-contained agent packaging — heartbeat agent could declare its own event-bus MCP rather than relying on global config. High integration complexity (automatic), good capability expansion for agent portability. Action: evaluate whether any existing agents would benefit from bundled mcpServers declarations.

evaluation.reasoning: New frontmatter field enables self-contained agents that bundle their own MCP server dependencies — distinct from global ~/.claude.json config. Heartbeat/orchestrator agents (pipeline-orchestrator, game-heartbeat-orchestrator) could declare event-bus MCP directly in frontmatter rather than requiring it in global config, improving portability and reducing global config surface. Integration complexity (80): YAML edit to agent frontmatter — trivial. Token efficiency (55): slight positive, reduces config fragmentation. Capability expansion (75): genuinely new agent packaging pattern, complementary to plugin bin/ executables. Maintenance (85): Anthropic-maintained frontmatter API, stable. Community validation (100): official release. Integration action: document new frontmatter key in INDEX.md + CLAUDE.md agent design patterns; evaluate which existing agents (event-bus-publisher, event-bus-reader, pipeline-orchestrator) would benefit from bundled mcpServers.
